$comment: Upstream source of truth for QA scenario DEFINITIONS only — results, owners, and defect links live in the Google Sheet and per-run artifacts, never here. Active tabs merged in v2: the installed-PWA iOS/Android tabs became one 'PWA' tab (device-specific rows keep their [iOS]/[Android] scenario prefix and MUST carry requiresProduction or requiresDevice), and 'Cross Surface' dissolved into concrete per-surface rows. Catalog v3 adds top-level journeys: ordered, role-aware choreography over active Test IDs. A case's kind may still be 'journey'; that category describes what the individual case verifies, while top-level journeys describe how people walk multiple cases together. Retired cases keep their historical tab and are never deleted; IDs are never reused. requiresProduction = cannot pass on localhost; requiresDevice = needs a real installed device; the 'tx' tag marks rows whose walk involves real wallet transactions. Every case carries exactly one 'kind' from the top-level kinds list — the public docs expose this category axis, while the QA app keeps its priority and area views; kind 'transaction' if and only if the row carries the 'tx' tag. Lifecycle: every case carries a 'status' from the top-level statuses list. A new case enters as active by pull request with the next number in its surface prefix; wording, step, and evidence edits stay in place; when what a case proves changes it is retired (retiredOn, retiredReason, optional replacedBy naming active successors) and the new check gets a new ID, so past verdicts keep their meaning. Every id ever issued is also registered in scripts/data/qa-test-id-ledger.json (append-only); the contract test rejects a catalog whose ids drift from that ledger.

statuses.means: Walked in sessions; ships to the QA app run sheet and the Test Cases page
No longer walked; keeps its ID, retirement date, and reason in the catalog and never ships to a run sheet

kinds.label: Accessibility

kinds.label: Resilience
kinds.verifies: Offline behavior, error recovery, updates, and performance degrade and recover honestly

steps.handoff: Wait until the Garden member can see the starting assessment.
Both people confirm the same Garden and open cycle are visible; the assessment is context, not a prerequisite.
Wait until the Request appears in the protocol pool for the Garden member.
The protocol reviewer waits for the pending Garden claim before accepting it.
Both people verify the Request remains in the protocol pool and names the Garden as provider.
The reviewer waits until the linked Work and evidence are visible before deciding.
Both people verify the approved Request is Fulfilled before moving to compensation.
The Garden member verifies the destination Garden Safe or its readiness state.
steps.knownGate: Protocol-to-Garden G$ settlement requires enabled settlement UI and value authority. If either is unavailable, record Blocked and continue with the non-value steps.

steps.handoff: Wait until the separate local commitment appears in the open Garden Campaign.
The reviewer waits for the local Work and evidence before opening review.
Both people verify the local commitment is complete and remains distinct from the protocol Request.
The Garden member verifies the receiving account or the visible readiness state.
steps.knownGate: Garden-to-member G$ settlement requires enabled contributor payout UI and value authority. If either is unavailable, record Blocked without changing the completed non-value workflow.
